The Challenge

Four Rounds.One ExtremeChampionship.

The Saudi Toyota Baja Championship is one of the Kingdom’s leading rally competitions, created to develop and promote rallying at both local and regional levels.

Across four rounds in different regions of Saudi Arabia, elite drivers and teams compete through varied desert landscapes, combining high speed with demanding technical challenges.

Each Baja round runs across multiple days and tests far more than outright pace. Drivers must maintain control, discipline, endurance, and precision while navigating changing terrain and long-distance off-road stages.
